rows.en: ＊Amane＊＠０１３＿００３Ow, ow...￥Oh, n-no, the seed bag's￥torn open...
＊Amane＊＠０１３＿００５Um, sorry, but... could you￥pick up the seeds that rolled￥over your way?
＊Amane＊＠０１３＿００８Phew, that should do it...￥Thanks for helping when you're￥tired from training!
＊Amane＊＠０１３＿００９Good, the pot didn't break!￥And the seeds look okay too.
＊Amane＊＠０１３＿０１１These are sunflower seeds!￥I brought them all the way￥from Sophia!
＊Amane＊＠０１３＿０１２I want to grow lots and lots￥more of them.
＊Amane＊＠０１３＿０１３And for that, see,￥I've got all kinds of￥stuff ready!
＊Amane＊＠０１３＿０１４Yep! So I brought a flowerpot￥and special fertilizer!
＊Amane＊＠０１３＿０１５These are sunflower seeds￥I brought all the way￥from Sophia!
＊Amane＊＠０１３＿０１６I'm gonna grow tons and￥tons more of them!
＊Amane＊＠０１３＿０１８Really? Yay, thank you! This￥stuff is pretty heavy on my own!
＊Amane＊＠０１３＿１９Of course! I'll be fi...ne,￥I think...? Hmm.
＊Amane＊＠０１３＿０２０Geez,￥if you're gonna say that,￥then help me!
＊Amane＊＠０１３＿０２１Aww, if I'd known, I would've￥borrowed a cart.
＊Amane＊＠０１３＿０２２Then I wouldn't have had to￥bother you... But don't worry,￥it's really close!
＊Amane＊＠０１３＿０２３Where? There's only one place on￥Alpha that has soil!
＊Amane＊＠０１３＿０２４Ahh--! I get it, you haven't￥really looked around Alpha￥yet, have you?
＊Amane＊＠０１３＿０２５I explored every nook and cranny￥the day I got here!
＊Amane＊＠０１３＿０２６See, there's a place called￥the Environmental Section.
＊Amane＊＠０１３＿０２７I'm gonna ask if I can plant￥the seeds there!
＊Amane＊＠０１３＿０２８But, but... you never said￥you didn't want to!
＊Amane＊＠０１３＿０２９And besides...￥I wanted to talk with you￥a little!!
＊Amane＊＠０１３＿０３０Come on! The Environmental￥Section is less than five￥minutes away!＝＠０１３＿０３１Let's chat for a bit, okay?
＊Amane＊＠０１４＿００１You know... once I've grown tons￥of these seeds, I'm gonna plant￥them on Elan!
＊Amane＊＠０１４＿００２Then, by the time everyone￥comes to Elan...
＊Amane＊＠０１４＿００４I think the people who come￥for the first time will feel￥a little uneasy deep down.
＊Amane＊＠０１４＿００５But if there were lots of￥familiar flowers blooming￥there...
＊Amane＊＠０１４＿００６I thought that alone might￥make them happy.
＊Amane＊＠０１４＿００９But when I think about going￥to Elan myself...＝＠０１４＿０１０it's fun and exciting, but I'm￥still kind of nervous too.
＊Amane＊＠０１４＿０１１So if even one person feels￥happy when they see the￥sunflowers, then...
＊Amane＊＠０１４＿０１３Actually...￥my mom always used to tell me...
＊Amane＊＠０１４＿０１４to put myself in other people's￥shoes and do what they most￥want me to do for them.
＊Amane＊＠０１４＿０１５That's really hard, though,￥isn't it? So... from now on,￥I'm gonna try my best!
＊Amane＊＠０１４＿０１７Thanks so much for helping￥me carry everything!
＊Amane＊＠０１４＿０１８I'll work hard to grow the￥sunflowers, so come see them￥sometime, okay?!
